about.title: A clinic that knows the neighbourhood
body: Rajan Clinic sits right on Kundrathur Main Road in Tharapakkam, tucked between Moulivakkam and Lawrence Nagar — close enough that most patients walk in rather than plan a special trip. That was always the idea: healthcare that fits into daily life here, not the other way around.

The clinic is built around a simple approach — see the patient promptly, listen properly, explain the diagnosis in plain Tamil or English, and treat what can be treated on the spot. For anything that needs a specialist, we say so honestly and point you in the right direction rather than keeping you waiting.

Families in Lakshme Nagar and the surrounding streets have relied on Rajan Clinic for everyday concerns — fevers, infections, blood pressure and sugar checks, minor injuries — and for the ongoing, unglamorous work of keeping chronic conditions under control year after year.

blogPosts.title: Managing Diabetes Doesn't Need a Hospital Visit Every Time
blogPosts.excerpt: Routine follow-ups for a chronic condition like diabetes work best close to home. Here's why a neighbourhood general physician is often the right fit.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Rajan Selvam
content: Diabetes and hypertension are conditions you manage for years, not weeks. That makes convenience just as important as expertise — a follow-up you keep postponing because the hospital is across town does you no good.

At Rajan Clinic, most of our long-term patients are people from Moulivakkam, Lawrence Nagar and Tharapakkam who found it easier to keep a regular schedule once the clinic was a five-minute walk or drive away rather than a planned trip.

Routine follow-ups don't need to be complicated: a quick review of your readings, a check on how the current medication is working, and an honest conversation about diet and lifestyle. We keep basic tests on-site so you're not making a separate trip to a lab just to track your numbers.
If you've been putting off a follow-up because it felt like too much effort, that's exactly the gap a neighbourhood clinic like ours is meant to close.
